en.quote: Do not save what is left after spending, but spend what is left after saving.
en.author: Warren Buffett

en.quote: If you buy things you do not need, soon you will have to sell things you need.
en.author: Warren Buffett

en.quote: Beware of little expenses; a small leak will sink a great ship.
en.author: Benjamin Franklin

en.quote: A penny saved is a penny earned.
en.author: Benjamin Franklin

en.quote: Never spend your money before you have earned it.
en.author: Thomas Jefferson

en.quote: The habit of saving is itself an education; it fosters every virtue, teaches self-denial, cultivates the sense of order, trains to forethought, and so broadens the mind.
en.author: T. T. Munger

en.quote: Wealth consists not in having great possessions, but in having few wants.
en.author: Epictetus

en.quote: Money is a terrible master but an excellent servant.
en.author: P. T. Barnum

en.quote: You must gain control over your money or the lack of it will forever control you.
en.author: Dave Ramsey

en.quote: Frugality includes all the other virtues.
en.author: Cicero

ar.quote: القرش الأبيض ينفع في اليوم الأسود.
ar.author: مثل عربي

ar.quote: ما قلّ وكفى خيرٌ مما كثر وألهى.
ar.author: مثل عربي

ar.quote: لا تدّخر ما يتبقى بعد الإنفاق، بل أنفق ما يتبقى بعد الادخار.
ar.author: وارن بافيت

ar.quote: إذا اشتريت ما لا تحتاج إليه، فسرعان ما ستبيع ما تحتاج إليه.
ar.author: وارن بافيت

ar.quote: احذر النفقات الصغيرة؛ فالثقب الصغير قد يُغرق سفينة كبيرة.
ar.author: بنيامين فرانكلين

ar.quote: لا تُنفق مالك قبل أن تكسبه.
ar.author: توماس جيفرسون

ar.quote: الثراء ليس في كثرة الممتلكات، بل في قلة الرغبات.
ar.author: إبيكتيتوس
